user_decision: C5 and C8 retained in the primary Figure 3G
method: LandSCENT-compatible signaling entropy rate and diffusion-map trajectory
primary_potency_model: different-variance Gaussian mixtures on log2(SR/(1-SR)); BIC over K=1..2 to reproduce the reference Figure 3G high/low landscape
default_maxPS5_sensitivity: BIC over K=1..5 is exported separately because LandSCENT default maxPS is 5
diffusion_gene_selection: LandSCENT mean>1 and SD>1 on log2(normalized abundance+1.1)

diffusion_map.kernel: adaptive Gaussian kernel with alpha=1 density normalization

root_rule: single cell with maximum SR among all retained C0-C8 cells
terminal_rule: two separated local maxima of graph-geodesic diffusion pseudotime from the SR root
interpretation_boundary: SR is an expression/PPI-based differentiation-potency proxy, not a lineage-tracing measurement. The diffusion map is a static transcriptional-state geometry. Root and terminal labels are computational predictions. C5 is mixed and C8 is immune-like.
